design_direction.rationale: Someone hiring a personal injury attorney after a serious accident needs proof of competence and results before anything else — the rating, the verdicts, the practice areas — not a warm photo tour of the office; the ledger architecture and a table-of-figures signature let the firm's actual track record do the persuading in a way a repeated licence stamp cannot.
design_direction.signature_why: A firm that wins verdicts and settlements should show its record as a ruled table of figures, not a repeated stamp, so the case results read like a document you'd trust rather than a badge.

blocks.heading: What does a Houston personal injury attorney do?
blocks.text: At its core, a Houston personal injury attorney exists to protect the legal rights of someone who has been injured, or the rights of a family that has lost a loved one, through no fault of their own. Under the law, the person or company responsible for causing that injury or death is required to pay for the harm and losses that result from it. That includes medical expenses already incurred and medical care that will be needed in the future, lost income and the loss of future earning capacity, and the pain, suffering, grief, and emotional toll the injury or loss has caused. In a wrongful death case, that also includes the profound loss a family experiences when a loved one is taken from them. blocks.heading: How do you choose a Houston Personal Injury Attorney?
blocks.text: Choosing the right Houston personal injury or wrongful death attorney is one of the most important decisions you will make after a serious injury or the loss of a loved one, and it deserves real research before you sign anything. Do not be afraid to ask direct questions. Ask about their trial results. Ask about the cases they have actually handled and how those cases were resolved. Ask how many seven and eight figure settlements or verdicts they have secured, both in the last year and over the last five years. A track record of real numbers tells you far more than a website ever will. Just as important is asking how the firm actually works day to day. Will you be speaking with your attorney directly, or will most of your communication go through a case manager or a paralegal you have never met? Do you have your attorney’s direct phone number? blocks.heading: How can a Houston Personal Injury Attorney help me?
blocks.text: A personal injury attorney in Houston can help you navigate the legal process after a serious injury and determine whether you have a viable claim. These cases often involve identifying who may be legally responsible for the harm you’ve suffered and understanding what types of damages and compensation may be available under the law. Attorneys assist with gathering evidence, preserving records, communicating with insurance companies, and advising you on how to move forward after an accident. If your case qualifies, your attorney may also represent you in pre-litigation negotiations or formal court proceedings. Working with a personal injury attorney can help protect your rights and ensure that the legal process accounts for the full extent of your injuries.

blocks.heading: What does it cost to hire a Houston Personal Injury Attorney?
blocks.text: Many personal injury attorneys, including those at our firm, work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront attorney fees. Instead, the attorney receives a percentage of the final recovery if the case is resolved successfully through settlement or judgment. The specific terms of this arrangement are discussed during the initial consultation. Clients are typically not responsible for attorney fees unless compensation is recovered. To learn more about what to expect when hiring a personal injury attorney , visit our detailed guide.

blocks.heading: What types of cases do personal injury attorneys handle?
blocks.text: Personal injury attorneys handle a wide range of legal matters involving injuries caused by the negligent or wrongful actions of others. These cases often include incidents such as car accidents, truck crashes , workplace injuries, product liability claims, premises liability, dog-related injuries, and slip-and-fall accidents. In each case, the attorney’s role is to determine whether a legal duty was breached and whether the injured person may be entitled to pursue compensation under the law.

blocks.heading: What happens if the insurance company denies my injury claim?
blocks.text: If your injury claim is denied, that does not necessarily mean you are out of legal options. Insurance claim denials can occur for a variety of reasons, including disputes about how the injury occurred, the extent of medical treatment, or who may be legally responsible. In some cases, an attorney may be able to review your documentation and gather additional evidence to challenge the denial. This could include medical records, police reports, witness statements, or expert input. If appropriate, your attorney may advise you to file a lawsuit and pursue recovery through the court system. Navigating a denied claim can be complex, especially when the facts are disputed. Speaking with a personal injury attorney may help clarify your next steps and protect your ability to seek compensation if it is available under the law.

blocks.heading: How long does a typical personal injury case take to resolve?
blocks.text: The timeline for a personal injury case varies depending on several factors, including the complexity of the facts, the severity of the injuries, and whether the parties involved are willing to negotiate. Some cases may settle within a few months, while others can take a year or longer, especially if a lawsuit is filed or the case proceeds to trial. For example, a case involving a minor injury with clear liability may resolve once medical treatment is complete and damages are documented. In contrast, cases involving long-term injuries or disputed liability often take more time due to extended negotiations or litigation. It is also important to wait until you reach what is called maximum medical improvement (MMI), which means your condition has stabilized. blocks.heading: What is the difference between a personal injury claim and a lawsuit?
blocks.text: A personal injury claim is the initial process of seeking compensation, typically through an insurance company, without filing a court case. It involves negotiating a resolution based on liability, medical records, and documented damages. A lawsuit, by contrast, is a formal legal action filed in civil court when the parties cannot reach an agreement through the claims process. Lawsuits involve legal pleadings, discovery, and may ultimately be decided by a judge or jury. Understanding this distinction is important because most personal injury cases begin as claims, but some require litigation to pursue recovery when negotiations are unsuccessful.

blocks.heading: Do I need a personal injury attorney if I already have insurance?
blocks.text: Having insurance can help cover certain expenses after an accident, but it may not reflect the full impact of your injuries. Policies often focus on immediate costs, like initial medical bills or property damage, and may not account for long-term medical care, future income loss, or non-economic harm such as pain and suffering. A personal injury attorney can evaluate your situation, explain your legal rights, and determine whether any additional claims may be appropriate. Legal guidance can also help protect you from signing away important rights too early in the process, especially if you’re facing pressure to settle quickly.

blocks.heading: Can I switch lawyers during a personal injury case?
blocks.text: Yes, clients generally have the right to change attorneys during a personal injury case. If you are concerned about communication, case strategy, or overall representation, you may choose to seek a second opinion or move your case to another law firm. Common reasons for switching lawyers include difficulty reaching your attorney, uncertainty about legal advice, or discomfort with how the case is progressing. A new attorney can review the current status of your case and explain any options moving forward. In many cases, the new attorney will coordinate the transfer of your file and work with your previous counsel to address any outstanding fees. Fee arrangements are usually handled through the final recovery and do not require clients to pay twice. blocks.heading: What is considered a serious injury in a personal injury case?
blocks.text: A serious injury typically involves long-term medical treatment, permanent disability, or significant disruption to daily life. Common examples include spinal cord injuries, traumatic brain injuries, amputations, and severe burns. In legal terms, these cases often involve more complex claims due to their lasting consequences.

testimonials.author: Roxana Valdez
testimonials.text:
I would like to express my sincere gratitude to this law firm for the outstanding job they did handling my accident case. From day one, they provided professional and compassionate service, always taking the time to answer my questions and keep me informed throughout the entire process.

Their dedication, experience, and commitment gave me peace of mind knowing that my case was in good hands. I highly recommend this law firm to anyone in need of legal representation after an accident. Thank you for all your hard work and support!
Thank you,
Mr Luke Maddox, Elvia Palacios and all the Ammons Law Firm.

testimonials.author: Joaquin Trevizo
testimonials.text:
I cannot say enough good things about Ammons Law Firm and the way they handled my case. From the very beginning, they treated me with respect, compassion, and genuine care. After my accident, I was dealing with a lot of stress, pain, and uncertainty, but their team was there every step of the way to guide me through the process. What stood out the most was that they never made me feel like just another case number. They took the time to listen to my concerns, answer my questions, and make sure I understood what was happening. I always felt like my well-being mattered to them, not just the outcome of the case. Their professionalism, communication, and dedication gave me confidence during one of the most difficult times in my life. If you’re looking for a law firm that truly cares about its clients and fights for them like family, I highly recommend Ammons Law Firm. Thank you to everyone at Ammons Law Firm for your hard work, support, and for making me feel valued throughout the entire process.

Joaquin Trevizo

testimonials.author: shaneris Stephens
testimonials.text:

Their attention to detail was exceptional — Kimberly was on point with coordinating flights, hotels, and meals during extended trial days, and ensuring everything was handled seamlessly.

They were also incredibly accommodating and thoughtful, particularly as I was a breastfeeding mother, going above and beyond to ensure my comfort and needs were met. Their professionalism, preparation, and commitment ultimately led to a successful outcome in my case. I highly recommend Ammons Law Firm to anyone seeking experienced, compassionate, and results-driven legal representation. If you want top notch care and the best chance at winning Ammons law firm has the top notch team to get you there.  Rob was definitely my David to Goliath(Uber).
